definitions.explanation: The fleshy part of the face below the eye and between the nose and ear.

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}ちゃんの{頬|ほほ}は{柔|やわ}らかい。
{頬|ほほ}に{涙|なみだ}が{流|なが}れた。

notes:
{頬|ほほ} refers to the cheeks of the face.

READINGS:
- {頬|ほほ}: standard reading
- {頬|ほお}: alternative reading (also common)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {頬|ほほ}を{膨|ふく}らます: to puff out one's cheeks (showing displeasure)
- {頬|ほほ}が{落|お}ちる: (food is) so delicious one's cheeks might fall off
- {頬|ほほ}{紅|べに}: blush, rouge
- {頬|ほほ}{杖|づえ}: resting one's chin in one's hand
- {頬|ほほ}{骨|ぼね}: cheekbone

RELATED WORDS:
- {頬|ほほ}える: to smile (showing on the cheeks)
- {頬|ほほ}ずり: rubbing cheeks together (as affection)
